newsitem.title: DUBAI: King Fahd sends sends aid to Palestinias.
newsitem.headline: King Fahd sends sends aid to Palestinias.

text.p: King Fahd of Saudi Arabia ordered his government on Wednesday to send two planeloads of food and medicine to ease the plight of Palestinians suffering under Israeli seige, the official Saudi press agency SPA said.
It gave no further details but said the aid would be flown to al-Areesh airport on the Egyptian side of the Gaza border from where it will be ferried to Palestinian self-rule areas.
Palestinians have blamed the Israeli closure of borders with their self-ruled areas for undermining their economy and forcing it to depend on handouts from donors.
Israel imposed the closure on the West bank and the Gaza Strip during a wave of Moslem suicide bombings that killed 59 people in Israel in February and March but has occasionally eased it.
Saudi-PLO ties have improved over the years from strains caused by the Gulf crisis, sparked by Iraq's August 1990 invasion of Kuwait.
